headline: France Braces for Transport Strikes and Nationwide Port Protests
summary: French dockworkers scheduled a strike, to be followed by nationwide protests and a multi-union general strike supporting labor demands.
why: France is a major European economic hub, and nationwide transport strikes frequently disrupt supply chains, logistics operations, and commercial activity across the region.

impacts.name: Transportation
impacts.why: Port and transport strikes interrupt cargo handling and passenger transit services.
